questions.explanation_ar: كلمة eraser بتبدأ بصوت متحرك (e)، فنقول an مش a. مثل: an eraser.
questions.explanation_en: The word eraser starts with a vowel sound (e), so we say an, not a. For example: an eraser.

questions.explanation_ar: كلمة door بتبدأ بصوت ساكن (d)، فنستخدم a. نقول: a door.
questions.explanation_en: The word door starts with a consonant sound (d), so we use a. We say: a door.

questions.prompt: — What's your name? — ___ name is Seif.
questions.explanation_ar: السؤال بيسأل عن اسمك، فالرد بيبدأ بـ My (اسمي). كلمة I معناها أنا، وYou معناها أنت.
questions.explanation_en: The question asks about your name, so the reply starts with My (اسمي). The word I means أنا, and You means أنت.

questions.explanation_ar: المعلم بيكتب على السبورة (board). الشنطة (bag) والمسطرة (ruler) مش بنكتب عليهم.
questions.explanation_en: The teacher writes on the board (board). We do not write on the bag (bag) or the ruler (ruler).

questions.prompt: You put your pens in a ___.
questions.explanation_ar: الأقلام بنحطها في المقلمة (pencil case). الشباك والباب مش أماكن للأقلام.
questions.explanation_en: We put pens in the pencil case (pencil case). The window and the door are not places for pens.

questions.prompt: We open the ___ to come into class.
questions.explanation_ar: بنفتح الباب (door) عشان ندخل الفصل. الكتاب والأستيكة مش بنفتحهم للدخول.
questions.explanation_en: We open the door (door) to enter the classroom. We do not open the book and the eraser to enter.

questions.explanation_ar: بنبص بره من الشباك (window). الكرسي والمكتب مش بنبص منهم بره.
questions.explanation_en: We look outside through the window (window). We do not look outside through the chair or the desk.

questions.prompt: Rub out the pencil with an ___.
questions.explanation_ar: بنمسح قلم الرصاص بالأستيكة (eraser). المسطرة بترسم خطوط، والسبورة بنكتب عليها. وكلمة eraser بتبدأ بصوت متحرك فنقول an.
questions.explanation_en: We erase pencil with the eraser (eraser). The ruler draws lines, and we write on the board. The word eraser starts with a vowel sound, so we say an.

questions.explanation_ar: الكلمة بين القوسين (كرسي) معناها chair، وبنقعد عليه. المكتب desk بنكتب عليه، والشنطة bag بنشيل فيها.
questions.explanation_en: The word in brackets (كرسي) means chair, and we sit on it. We write on the desk (desk), and we carry things in the bag (bag).

questions.prompt: You carry your books in a ___.
questions.explanation_ar: بنشيل الكتب في الشنطة (bag). السبورة والمسطرة مش بنشيل فيهم حاجة.
questions.explanation_en: We carry books in the bag (bag). We do not carry anything in the board or the ruler.

questions.explanation_ar: بنرسم الخطوط المستقيمة بالمسطرة (ruler). الكتاب والباب مش بنرسم بيهم.
questions.explanation_en: We draw straight lines with the ruler (ruler). We do not draw with the book or the door.

questions.explanation_ar: مع this (ده) بنستخدم is. am بتيجي مع I، وare بتيجي مع كذا واحد. نقول: This is a desk.
questions.explanation_en: With this (ده) we use is. am goes with I, and are goes with more than one. We say: This is a desk.

questions.explanation_ar: مع that (ده بعيد) بنستخدم is لأنه شيء واحد. am وare مش مناسبين هنا.
questions.explanation_en: With that (ده بعيد) we use is because it is one thing. am and are do not fit here.

questions.explanation_ar: كلمة Goodbye بنقولها وإحنا ماشيين، ومعناها مع السلامة. مرحبًا معناها Hello، وشكرًا معناها Thank you.
questions.explanation_en: We say Goodbye when we leave, and it means مع السلامة. مرحبًا is Hello, and شكرًا is Thank you.

questions.explanation_ar: كلمة teacher معناها معلم. طالب هي student، وباب هي door.
questions.explanation_en: The word teacher means معلم. طالب is student, and باب is door.

questions.explanation_ar: بنقول This is a book لأن book واحد قريب منا. These وThose للجمع، وبعدهم are.
questions.explanation_en: We say This is a book because there is one book near us. These and Those are for plurals, and they are followed by are.

questions.explanation_ar: Hello, I'm Mariam معناها أنا مريم. I'm اختصار I am. كلمة I لوحدها محتاجة am بعدها، وmy معناها بتاعي.
questions.explanation_en: Hello, I'm Mariam means "Hello, I am Mariam." I'm is short for I am. The word I alone needs am after it, and my means بتاعي.

questions.explanation_ar: بنقرا الكتاب (book). الباب بنفتحه، والكرسي بنقعد عليه.
questions.explanation_en: We read the book (book). We open the door, and we sit on the chair.

questions.explanation_ar: كلمة bag بتبدأ بصوت ساكن (b)، فنقول a bag. مع الكلمات اللي بتبدأ بصوت ساكن نستخدم a.
questions.explanation_en: The word bag starts with a consonant sound (b), so we say a bag. With words that start with a consonant sound we use a.

questions.explanation_ar: What's your name? معناها اسمك إيه؟ What's اختصار What is. كلمة How بتسأل عن الحال مش الاسم.
questions.explanation_en: What's your name? means "What is your name?" What's is short for What is. The word How asks about how someone is, not the name.

questions.explanation_ar: المدرسة Hoda بتعلمنا الإنجليزي، يعني هي معلمة: teacher. باقي الكلمات أدوات مش أشخاص.
questions.explanation_en: Ms. Hoda teaches us English, so she is a teacher: teacher. The other words are tools, not people.

questions.explanation_ar: الساندوتش بنحطه في الشنطة (bag). المقلمة للأقلام، والمكتب بنكتب عليه.
questions.explanation_en: We put the sandwich in the bag (bag). The pencil case is for pens, and we write on the desk.

questions.prompt: Knock on the ___ before you come in. (الباب)
questions.explanation_ar: بنخبط على الباب (door) قبل ما ندخل. الكلمة العربية (الباب) هي الدليل.
questions.explanation_en: We knock on the door (door) before we enter. The Arabic word (الباب) is the clue.

questions.prompt: The ___ is on the wall. We write on it.
questions.explanation_ar: بنكتب على السبورة (board) اللي على الحيطة. الجملة بتقول: We write on it.
questions.explanation_en: We write on the board (board) on the wall. The sentence says: We write on it.

questions.prompt: I have a new ___ to draw lines.
questions.explanation_ar: بنرسم الخطوط بالمسطرة (ruler). الجملة فيها: to draw lines.
questions.explanation_en: We draw lines with the ruler (ruler). The sentence has: to draw lines.

questions.explanation_ar: القلم الرصاص بنحطه في المقلمة (pencil case). الكلمة العربية (المقلمة) هي الدليل.
questions.explanation_en: We put the pencil in the pencil case (pencil case). The Arabic word (المقلمة) is the clue.

questions.prompt: I look through the ___ and see the birds in the sky. (الشباك)
questions.explanation_ar: بنبص من الشباك (window) ونشوف الطيور. الكلمة العربية (الشباك) هي الدليل.
questions.explanation_en: We look from the window (window) and see the birds. The Arabic word (الشباك) is the clue.

questions.prompt: Your books are on the ___ in front of you. (المكتب)
questions.explanation_ar: الكتب موجودة على المكتب (desk) اللي قدامك. الكلمة العربية (المكتب) هي الدليل.
questions.explanation_en: The books are on the desk (desk) in front of you. The Arabic word (المكتب) is the clue.

questions.prompt: This ___ is pink. It rubs out pencil.
questions.explanation_ar: الجملة بتقول إنها بتمسح قلم الرصاص، يعني الأستيكة (eraser).
questions.explanation_en: The sentence says she is erasing the pencil, which means the eraser (eraser).

questions.explanation_ar: بنقعد على الكرسي (chair). الكلمة العربية (الكرسي) هي الدليل.
questions.explanation_en: We sit on the chair (chair). The Arabic word (الكرسي) is the clue.

questions.explanation_ar: pencil case معناها مقلمة، وهي اللي بنحط فيها الأقلام.
questions.explanation_en: pencil case means مقلمة, and it is what we keep pens in.

questions.explanation_en: board means سبورة, and it is what the teacher writes on.

questions.explanation_en: The words: window and this. We start with This, then is, then a window. The sentence: This is a window. We start with a capital letter and end with a full stop.

questions.explanation_en: The words: eraser and that. The word eraser starts with a vowel sound, so we say an. The sentence: That is an eraser.

questions.explanation_ar: الجملة بتعرّف باسمك: My name is Adam. نبدأ بحرف كبير، واسم Adam كمان بحرف كبير.
questions.explanation_en: The sentence introduces your name: My name is Adam. We start with a capital letter, and the name Adam also starts with a capital letter.
